source.author: verg
source.text: Di tibi, si qua pios respectant numina, si quid usquam iustitia est et mens sibi conscia recti, praemia digna ferant.
source.text_original: Di tibi, si qua pios respectant numina, si quid / usquam iustitia est et mens sibi conscia recti, / praemia digna ferant.
source.text_english: May the gods bring you worthy rewards, if any divine powers anywhere regard the righteous, if there is any justice at all, and if the mind is conscious to itself of what is right.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nam licet te publicae rei necessitas a ueris et iustis operibus auertat, tamen fieri non potest quin subinde in caelum aspiciat mens sibi conscia recti.
reuse.text_original: nam licet te publicae rei necessitas a ueris et iustis operibus auertat, tamen fieri non potest quin subinde in caelum aspiciat mens sibi conscia recti.
reuse.text_english: For although the necessity of public affairs may turn you away from true and righteous deeds, nevertheless it is impossible that the mind, conscious of its own rightness, should not from time to time look up to heaven.
